nodes.label: Asymmetric Masking Design
nodes.rationale: Only REQUEST bodies are masked (outbound to Anthropic). System field and assistant prose are skipped intentionally: masking distorts model directives and assistant output carries no original user PII. tool_use inputs are masked because they may contain user-authored text verbatim (e.g. new_string in Edit).

nodes.label: System Reminder Preservation
nodes.rationale: <system-reminder> blocks in user messages contain trusted machine-generated content (skills list, CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md) injected by Claude Code harness — not user-authored PII. NLP models incorrectly flag these (e.g. 'Claude' as PERSON, dates, IPs). They are passed through unchanged to avoid breaking session context.

nodes.label: Person Allowlist False Positive Filter
nodes.rationale: Product names like 'Claude' are misclassified as PERSON entities by spaCy NER. An allowlist filters these before anonymization to prevent over-masking of legitimate product-name content in user messages.
